audiowave.title: Audio Waveform
audiowave.noDevice: No audio output detected. Play something, or check your default playback device.
audiowave.perfNotice: The audio waveform widget continuously captures your speaker output and repaints in real time, so it uses some CPU/GPU (usually a few percent, more with heavier styles). Only audio is analysed on this device — nothing is recorded or sent. You can turn it off any time in Settings.
